Jared: heads-up — noticed incident-bot posted an event to #incidents at 01:40 but PagerDuty never paged the primary. :rotating_light:
Jared: scraping the webhook logs now — looks like Pagerflow (our pd-proxy) returned a 502 for a bunch of deliveries around 01:40-01:42
Jared: sample from the proxy log: `POST /pd/v1/events 502 1.2s` repeated 18x
Oncall Bot: attempted to create incident for alert 'inference-runtime-high-latency' at 01:40:21, API response 502, retrying 3/3
Priya: omg, we had a deployment to pagerflow yesterday night. Did we roll back the config?
Emily K: doesn't look like a config change — I see a spike in backend errors in pagerflow logs starting 01:39, upstream PD TLS handshakes failing intermittently
Nate: PD status page shows no outage, so this looks internal to our proxy or networking to PD
Sam: rolled a quick healthcheck: `curl -v https://pagerflow.internal/pd/health` -> 200, but `/pd/v1/events` handler returning 502 with body `upstream error`
Priya: can someone run `kubectl logs -ninfra pagerflow-0 --since=30m` and paste the chunk around 01:39?
Jared: pasted snippet: ```
2026-03-14T01:39:58Z ERROR upstream: TLS handshake failure: remote error: handshake failure
2026-03-14T01:40:02Z WARN retrying request to PD
2026-03-14T01:40:14Z ERROR upstream: connection reset by peer
```
Oncall Bot: note — incident-bot marked incident as 'created' in our channel but failed external-page; it set incident status to PENDING_EXTERNAL_ACK
Emily K: immediate mitigation: we need to enable manual fallback so SRE can page via PD UI and update on-call rotations. Who's taking first manual page?
Nate: I'll do it. paging now to oncall via PD web UI and SMS for the alerts that were missed.
Priya: running a quick restart of pagerflow pod to clear possibly stale TLS sessions: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/pagerflow -n infra`
ops-automation: queued reprocess job for failed deliveries (job id 9f2c) — will attempt replay against PD API after restart
Jared: manual page sent at 01:47 to primary SRE, got ack from Nate at 01:49. Customers notified via internal status page: "Investigating delayed alerting"
Sam: after restart, new logs show PD responses 200 for `/pd/v1/events`; replay job started and 14/18 previously failed deliveries succeeded
Emily K: good. still want to figure out root cause — TLS handshake failures look like an intermittent network/NAT issue between our Egress nodes and PD edge
Priya: opened ticket with infra networking (link: https://internal.redwood/ops/tickets/2642) to look at egress path and NAT table. tagging net-eng on the ticket. @Nate please include timestamps and sample trace ids
Nate: done. added traces and the replay job id.
Oncall Bot: incident-bot note: created internal incident RED-2026-0314-1, status: RESPONDED (manual paging used as fallback)
Jared: quick customer-impact assessment: delayed pages for 12 internal alerts, no downstream customer-facing outage observed (metrics still within SLO), but delays could cause alerting gaps if PD integration flaps again
Emily K: agreed — we should set temporary runbook to manual fallback if pagerflow error rate > 5% for 5m: step-by-step "kick off manual paging, restart pagerflow, reprocess queue, open network ticket"
Priya: I'll draft the runbook and post it to /runbooks/pagerflow-fallback.md after this thread
Sam: for post-incident, propose: add retries with exponential backoff + jitter, and instrument TLS handshake failures as a specific alert so we stop relying on aggregate 5xx
Nate: also propose a k8s preStop hook that gracefully closes TLS sockets before drain — might reduce handshake drop during rolling restarts
Jared: timeline summary to paste into incident doc: 01:40 proxy TLS failures -> 01:40-01:42 failed deliveries -> 01:47 manual page -> 01:49 ack -> 01:52 pagerflow restart -> 01:55 replay success 14/18 -> ticket opened for net-eng
Priya: assigning postmortem owners: Emily (infra root cause), Sam (pagerflow reliability), Nate (oncall/runbook). I'll coordinate write-up and a quick blameless review tomorrow 10:00 PT
Emily K: note for public/status-page: wording should be "Delayed alerting due to internal paging proxy errors; monitoring and workaround in place; no customer-facing service degradation observed." I'll draft a blurb after the postmortem
Nate: leaving handoff to Priya at 02:15 PT — will update notes in the incident doc and then go offline
Priya: acknowledged. thanks everyone for fast manual fallback. :thumbsup:
Oncall Bot: automated note: incident closed to RESPONDING -> MONITORING after replay succeeded; awaiting postmortem
Jared: follow-ups: add egress NAT pool healthcheck, add TLS handshake metric, implement small SLO for pagerflow delivery success, and add a PD fallback toggle in Console to let product teams trigger manual notify if paging fails
Sam: adding items to backlog now. will link PRs in the postmortem doc
Priya: closing thread — moving to incident tracker RED-2026-0314-1 and scheduling postmortem session.
